recognize_zh: 淋巴結高倍視野中，一個濾泡的生發中心邊界被破壞，淡染的組織球與嗜酸性物質侵入並打散生發中心細胞，套區不完整，即濾泡溶解（folliculolysis），是 Kimura 病的特徵之一。
features: Germinal center with disrupted, irregular borders and loss of the sharp mantle interface
Infiltration of the germinal center by pale histiocytes, eosinophilic material and scattered inflammatory cells
Mixed centroblasts and centrocytes separated into irregular clusters
Surrounding sheets of small mature lymphocytes
Small vessel within the follicle; eosinophils difficult to resolve individually at this magnification
describe_en: Lymph node section shows a reactive follicle whose germinal center has ill-defined, disrupted borders. The germinal center is infiltrated and broken up by pale histiocytes, eosinophilic proteinaceous material and scattered inflammatory cells, with residual centroblasts and centrocytes in irregular clusters. The mantle zone is attenuated and surrounded by sheets of small lymphocytes. No atypical large cells are seen. Findings are consistent with folliculolysis, which in the context of eosinophilia and eosinophilic microabscesses supports Kimura disease.

ddx.vs: HIV lymphadenitis shows florid follicular hyperplasia with folliculolysis and polykaryocytes but lacks eosinophilic microabscesses, with HIV serology confirming.
PTGC shows large nodules in which mantle lymphocytes invade the germinal center without eosinophilic material or histiocytic disruption.
Neoplastic follicles are back-to-back, monotonous, lack tingible body macrophages and are BCL2 positive, unlike disrupted reactive germinal centers.
IgG4-related disease shows increased IgG4-positive plasma cells with an IgG4/IgG ratio above 40% rather than IgE deposits and eosinophilic microabscesses.
